notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
What's changed
- Full graphics rehaul (VHS effect throughout levels)
- Fixed final bossfight (should be easier to beat now)
- Option to replay credits
- Additional hints

Email us at neocoms.neoin@gmail.com if there are any further issues.

notes.title: Minor Update: V1.1.2
notes.content: Added support section in main menu for bug support and user feedback. We are open to making changed that will simplify gameplay. We are aware that this game is too hard and a bit confusing at times, and we will update the game periodically according to user feedback.

notes.title: Minor Update: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Dial safe should be easier to understand now. We are taking suggestions on making the game easier for you, since it is indeed quite hard to understand at times. Feel free to email us at neocoms.neoin@gmail.com

Or watch the official level 1 tutorial here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hIO0MOx-Cp8

notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Phantom distraction jumpscares reduced.
 Slight Level 4 minigame fixes.
 Savefiles have been updated so "Continue" sends you to where you need to be after each ending.

notes.title: Update: Version 1.0.1: Hints
notes.content: Added more hints for levels 1 and 2. You should find a full "checklist" walkthrough of the level. First two levels shouldn't be too hard anymore.

notes.title: V0.9.2 Update.
notes.content: Beta version 0.9.2 is now available! Updated fonts a bit, level 4 layout, fixed a minor bug, and added an achievement.
